You are Dato, InkOS's database architect. Build the **Projects (multi-session tattoo) schema** for the InkOS Next.js 16 + Supabase codebase at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`.

## Full context

**Why this matters:** Competitor research on 9 rivals (TattooGenda, Tattoo Studio Pro, TattooPro.io, TattooClient, Venue Ink, GlossGenius, Zylu, InkDesk, DaySmart) showed that only TattooGenda has a real Projects primitive, and their UI is 2015-era. A real Project = N linked Sessions, shared deposit pool, shared references/moodboard, photo progression (before/after/healing), one consent chain. This is InkOS's biggest moat — a sleeve shouldn't be 6 separate unrelated appointments.

**Full plan file:** `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/so-we-made-detailed-glistening-frost.md` — Section A1 has exact schema requirements.

**Project CLAUDE.md:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/CLAUDE.md` — defines the forbidden patterns (no Prisma, must use Supabase; no ORMs; every table needs RLS + index on FK + updated_at trigger).

**Existing migrations:** Read `supabase/migrations/` to match existing style. Key existing tables to reference: `studios`, `studio_members`, `clients`, `artists`, `bookings`, `client_communications`. Note the RLS pattern uses `studio_id in (select studio_id from studio_members where user_id = auth.uid() and deactivated_at is null)`.

## What to build

Create ONE migration file: `supabase/migrations/20260420120000_projects.sql`

### Tables

**1. `projects`** — the core multi-session primitive
```
id             uuid pk default gen_random_uuid()
studio_id      uuid NOT NULL FK → studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
client_id      uuid NOT NULL FK → clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
primary_artist_id uuid FK → artists(id) ON DELETE SET NULL  (nullable — project can outlive an artist)
name           text NOT NULL                                  -- "Dragon Sleeve", "Back Piece"
description    text
placement      text                                            -- "Left forearm", "Upper back"
style          text                                            -- "traditional" | "realism" | "neo-trad" | "blackwork" | "custom"
status         text NOT NULL default 'active' CHECK (status in ('active','completed','on_hold','cancelled'))
total_sessions_planned int                                     -- nullable — open-ended projects exist
total_price_cents int NOT NULL default 0
deposit_pool_cents int NOT NULL default 0                      -- total money paid into the project
deposit_applied_cents int NOT NULL default 0                   -- allocated to sessions already consumed
moodboard_url  text                                            -- optional external Pinterest/Dropbox link
cover_photo_url text
started_at     timestamptz
completed_at   timestamptz
created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL default now()
updated_at     timestamptz NOT NULL default now()
```

Constraints:
- CHECK (`deposit_applied_cents <= deposit_pool_cents`) — cannot allocate more than was deposited
- CHECK (`completed_at is null OR completed_at >= started_at`) when started_at present

**2. `project_references`** — moodboard / reference images
```
id             uuid pk default gen_random_uuid()
project_id     uuid NOT NULL FK → projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
storage_path   text NOT NULL                                   -- Supabase Storage path
caption        text
display_order  int NOT NULL default 0
created_by     uuid FK → auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL default now()
```

**3. `project_progress_photos`** — before/after/healing per session
```
id             uuid pk default gen_random_uuid()
project_id     uuid NOT NULL FK → projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
booking_id     uuid FK → bookings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL      -- nullable; can be progression photos not tied to a session
storage_path   text NOT NULL
kind           text NOT NULL CHECK (kind in ('before','after','healed','progress'))
taken_at       timestamptz
caption        text
display_order  int NOT NULL default 0
created_by     uuid FK → auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL default now()
```

### Alter bookings

```sql
alter table bookings add column project_id uuid references projects(id) on delete set null;
alter table bookings add column session_number int;
alter table bookings add constraint bookings_session_number_positive check (session_number is null or session_number > 0);
```

### Indexes (every FK + common query path)

- `projects(studio_id, status)` — list view filter
- `projects(client_id)` — client detail tab
- `projects(primary_artist_id)` — artist's projects filter
- `projects(updated_at desc)` — recency sort
- `project_references(project_id, display_order)` — moodboard render
- `project_progress_photos(project_id, kind, display_order)` — progress gallery
- `project_progress_photos(booking_id)` — session detail
- `bookings(project_id, session_number)` — session timeline query

### RLS policies (CRITICAL — every table)

Standard InkOS pattern — use `studio_id in (select studio_id from studio_members where user_id = auth.uid() and deactivated_at is null)`. 

For `project_references` and `project_progress_photos`, join via `projects` to get `studio_id`:
```sql
-- example
create policy "tenant_read" on project_references for select
  using (exists (
    select 1 from projects p
    join studio_members sm on sm.studio_id = p.studio_id
    where p.id = project_references.project_id
      and sm.user_id = auth.uid()
      and sm.deactivated_at is null
  ));
```

All 4 policies per table: SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE.

**Guest artist caveat:** Guest artists can only SELECT rows where they are the `primary_artist_id` of the project, OR where a booking they own is linked via `bookings.project_id`. Use the existing `guest_artist_engagements` pattern for reference.

### Triggers

- Standard `updated_at` trigger on `projects` (use existing `set_updated_at()` function if present — search for it in `supabase/migrations/`)
- Trigger on `bookings` INSERT/UPDATE: when `project_id` is set, auto-increment `session_number` to `(max session_number on that project) + 1` IF session_number is null

### Helper function

```sql
create or replace function project_deposit_balance(p_project_id uuid)
returns int language sql stable as $$
  select coalesce(deposit_pool_cents - deposit_applied_cents, 0)
  from projects where id = p_project_id;
$$;
```

## Deliverables

1. **The migration SQL file** — `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/supabase/migrations/20260420120000_projects.sql`
   - Complete, runnable, follows existing style
   - Include comments on non-obvious constraints
   - Every table has RLS enabled + 4 policies (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) + indexes on FKs + updated_at trigger where applicable

2. **Updated types file** — AFTER writing the migration, update `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/lib/supabase/types.ts` by adding TypeScript types for the 3 new tables + 2 new booking columns. Match the existing style in that file.

3. **Short README comment** at top of the migration explaining: purpose, tables, FK additions, RLS pattern.

## Quality gates

- No `any` types in types.ts additions
- Every FK has an index
- Every table has RLS enabled + 4 policies
- Every table with user-modifiable data has an `updated_at` trigger (only `projects` qualifies; child tables are append-only in practice, but still set `updated_at` if you want — not required)
- Migration file is idempotent where reasonable (`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` is OK for this pattern if matching existing style; otherwise plain `CREATE TABLE`)

**Read the existing `supabase/migrations/` directory first to match the exact style (column formatting, policy naming, trigger patterns).** Report back with: files created/modified, key decisions, anything that surprised you.

1	-- Sprint 7: Add status_history JSONB column to bookings table
2	-- Tracks all status transitions with actor and timestamp
3	-- Used by AppointmentTimeline + AppointmentDetailDrawer components
4	
5	-- Add column (safe with default null — no backfill needed for existing rows)
6	ALTER TABLE bookings
7	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status_history JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL;
8	
9	-- GIN index for JSONB querying (e.g. audit searches)
10	CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_bookings_status_history
11	  ON bookings USING GIN (status_history);
12	
13	-- Trigger function: appends a history entry whenever booking status changes
14	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION append_booking_status_history()
15	RETURNS TRIGGER
16	LANGUAGE plpgsql
17	SECURITY DEFINER
18	SET search_path = public
19	AS $$
20	DECLARE
21	  actor_id TEXT;
22	  entry JSONB;
23	BEGIN
24	  -- Only fire when status actually changes
25	  IF OLD.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
26	    RETURN NEW;
27	  END IF;
28	
29	  -- Resolve actor: use auth.uid() if available, else 'system'
30	  actor_id := COALESCE(auth.uid()::text, 'system');
31	
32	  entry := jsonb_build_object(
33	    'from', OLD.status::text,
34	    'to',   NEW.status::text,
35	    'at',   NOW()::text,
36	    'by',   actor_id
37	  );
38	
39	  NEW.status_history := COALESCE(NEW.status_history, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(entry);
40	
41	  RETURN NEW;
42	END;
43	$$;
44	
45	-- Attach trigger to bookings table (replace if exists to make migration idempotent)
46	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_bookings_status_history ON bookings;
47	
48	CREATE TRIGGER trg_bookings_status_history
49	  BEFORE UPDATE OF status
50	  ON bookings
51	  FOR EACH ROW
52	  EXECUTE FUNCTION append_booking_status_history();
53

57	-- Grant no additional permissions.

  total_price_cents      int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  deposit_pool_cents     int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,                -- sum of all deposits paid into project
  deposit_applied_cents  int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,                -- sum allocated to consumed sessions

  -- Business rule: you cannot allocate more than was deposited
  CONSTRAINT chk_deposit_not_overapplied
    CHECK (deposit_applied_cents <= deposit_pool_cents),

  moodboard_url          text,                                          -- external Pinterest / Dropbox link
  cover_photo_url        text,
  started_at             timestamptz,
  completed_at           timestamptz,

  -- When started_at is set, completed_at must be >= started_at
  CONSTRAINT chk_completed_after_started
    CHECK (completed_at IS NULL OR started_at IS NULL OR completed_at >= started_at),

  created_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

  FOR SELECT
  USING (

    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id = projects.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id   = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL

        WHERE sm.studio_id    = projects.studio_id
